title: 8-K/A
主要内容: Nicholas Financial, Inc. reported compensation earned by interim Chief Executive Officer Michael Rost during specific periods. From April 1, 2021 through May 9, 2022, Rost earned $238,752. From April 1, 2020 through March 31, 2021, he earned $196,823. From April 1, 2019 through March 31, 2020, he earned $173,267. The report is in compliance with regulatory requirements.
